messages.自分のお札を5まで溜め、S3「破裂符」で敵にお札5を押し付けて、敵が攻撃を受ける: Build 5 Talismans on himself, then use S3 Rupturing Talisman to transfer 5 to the enemy, causing Rupture application whenever that enemy is hit. Talismans consume Rupture Count quickly, so allies that supply Count are essential.
messages.敵に貼ったお札: お札を持つ対象は、被ダメージ時に(お札÷2)の破裂を得て、お札: **Talismans on enemies**: A target with Talismans gains (Talisman ÷ 2) Rupture when it takes damage, and Talisman decreases by 1 (minimum 1 gained, rounded down). It only decreases at Turn End when it is 6 or more, so at 5 or less it stays until the bearer is hit.
messages.S3「破裂符」: Ⅰコインの的中時に自分のお札を5消耗し、対象にお札5を付与する: **S3 — Rupturing Talisman**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, spends 5 of his own Talismans and gives the target 5 Talismans. It only works while he has 5 or more Talismans. On Coin Ⅱ hit, if the target has Talismans, Rupture Count increases by 1/3. The transfer is on the first Coin, so land it as a one-sided attack or with a sure Clash Win so it is not broken.
messages.お札の獲得: S2「増殖するお札」の各コイン、S1「傷口浮彫」(表面的中時、対象: **Gaining Talismans**: He gains 1 Talisman with each Coin of S2 Proliferating Talismans, with S1 Magnify Wound (on Heads Hit, if the target has at least 5 Rupture), and on using his Defense skill Guard. The combat passive Unfixing Talismans (3 Gluttony Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants 1 Talisman on hit if the target has Rupture.
messages.自分が持つお札: 最大6。攻撃的中時に対象の破裂回数を1消耗して(お札÷2)の破: **Talismans on himself**: Maximum 6. On hit, they consume 1 of the target's Rupture Count to inflict (Talisman ÷ 2) Rupture (minimum 1 if Rupture Count was consumed, rounded down), and when he takes damage, he gains (Talisman ÷ 2) Rupture and Talisman decreases by 1. At 6 or more at Turn End, all of it is spent and he takes fixed damage equal to its value.
messages.S1・S2(とパッシブ)でお札を5まで溜め、6以上のままターンを終えないよう枚数: Build Talismans to 5 with S1 and S2 (and the passive), adjusting the count so he does not end a turn at 6 or more. Once at 5 or more, push them onto an enemy with S3 so allies' subsequent attacks trigger Rupture repeatedly. The Talisman effect consumes extra Rupture Count, so pair him with allies who can extend Rupture Count (Rupture teams) to maintain it.
